research.age_policy: canonical_age_years is null unless explicitly supported; casting_age is not canon.
research.gender_policy: Top-level gender is a proposed Gemini vocal presentation. profile.canonical_gender is separately evidenced or null.
research.scope: 59 voice profile tokens. Canonical installed-game source speakers are a version-specific subset; retained inactive profiles cover later/newer translation content and are not deleted solely because the installed 0.9.20 source lacks them.
research.approval_policy: All new voices remain uncreated and unapproved. No API request is made by validation/export.
